tables.name: perspective_nose_vs_ear_magnification_by_distance
tables.units: camera-to-nose-tip distance in m; magnification is dimensionless (nose-tip plane relative to tragion plane)
tables.population: n/a (pinhole geometry); d = nose-tip-to-tragion depth, assumed 9-12 cm adult
tables.notes: Derived: m = 1 + d/Z. The 9-12 cm depth range is expert knowledge, not sourced. Use for perspective-guard warnings (e.g. warn when Z < 0.8 m, m > ~1.12). Cross-check against Ward et al. 2018 'selfie effect' study.

tables.name: tight_head_framing_distance_by_focal
tables.units: focal in mm (35 mm-equivalent); distance in m; magnification dimensionless
tables.population: n/a (geometry); portrait orientation, 36 mm sensor side vertical, 0.35 m field
tables.notes: distance = f * 0.35 / 0.036. Shows that perspective is set by distance; focal length only fixes framing.

tables.name: focal_35mm_equivalent_width_vs_diagonal_convention
rows: focal ~4% short -> camera solved too close, face too deep
tables.notes: Ratios are exact geometry. Which convention a given phone/camera uses when writing EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm is not verified here; face3d.geometry.camera.focal_px_from_35mm assumes diagonal.

tables.name: likeness_sanity_check_proportions
tables.population: adults, mixed sex and ancestry; broad ranges
tables.notes: Sanity checks only, not priors for a specific person. Cross-check against the anatomy/craniometric-landmarks note and Farkas 1994 before use as priors.
